sprite_sequence.text: No, no, no -- not on the very first day!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels panicked and flustered, with a burst of frustrated disbelief at being late on the very first day and a strong urge to fix it immediately.
sprite_sequence.label: exasperated

sprite_sequence.text: Stupid alarm, why did you die today of all days?!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is flustered and panicked, with a burst of irritated self-directed frustration at the alarm for ruining her first day.
sprite_sequence.label: exasperated

sprite_sequence.text: Mom's going to say it was fate punishing me for scrolling at midnight...
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s flustered and self-mocking, half-panicked about being late but trying to lighten it with a joking complaint that hides her embarrassment and frustration.
sprite_sequence.label: exasperated

sprite_sequence.text: Wait, seriously? They never open this gate.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She shifts from frantic panic to startled, hopeful curiosity, feeling a sudden rush of relief at the unexpected shortcut while still being wary that something is off.
sprite_sequence.label: surprised

sprite_sequence.text: Yeah, that was the problem, thanks.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels flustered and irritated at being told the obvious, but her embarrassment is softened by a quick, sarcastic attempt to keep control of the situation.
sprite_sequence.label: exasperated

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels wary and puzzled, with a flicker of curiosity as she tries to make sense of the girl’s oddly precise warning.
sprite_sequence.label: uneasy_confused

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels startled and suspicious, with a flash of self-conscious unease as she tries to push back against the stranger’s unsettling familiarity.
sprite_sequence.label: uneasy_confused

sprite_sequence.text: How do you know that before the board goes up?
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels sharply startled and uneasy, with her usual quick wit turning into wary suspicion as she tries to make sense of how this stranger could know something so specific.
sprite_sequence.label: uneasy_confused

sprite_sequence.text: Okay, wow. Creepy. Helpful, maybe, but creepy.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s startled and uneasy, but trying to regain control by joking through her nerves and treating the stranger’s eerie help with wary curiosity.
sprite_sequence.label: uneasy_confused

sprite_sequence.text: Yes! I might actually make it!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels a sudden burst of relieved, energized optimism, with her earlier panic easing into excited determination that she can still salvage the morning.
sprite_sequence.label: natural_smile_cheerful

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is stunned and shaken, realizing the stranger’s warning was real and feeling a sudden spike of uneasy fear mixed with disbelief.
sprite_sequence.label: uneasy_confused

sprite_sequence.text: She said not to use the east stairs.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels a sharp, uneasy jolt of vindicated fear, realizing the stranger’s creepy warning may have just saved her and that something unsettling is going on.
sprite_sequence.label: uneasy_confused

sprite_sequence.text: Oh, come on. Don't do this to me on day one.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels a sharp mix of alarm and frustrated disbelief, with her earlier nerves turning into a dawning sense that something uncanny is happening and she needs to stay alert.
sprite_sequence.label: uneasy_confused

sprite_sequence.text: Fine. School first. Panic attack later.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is forcing herself into brisk, joking composure to stay functional, while underneath she’s shaken, anxious, and trying hard not to let fear take over.
sprite_sequence.label: uneasy_confused
